name: open-accountant-wilson
description: Private bookkeeping on your own computer: import bank files, see where your money went, categorize, budgets and goals.
long_description:
Wilson keeps your bank transactions in a private database on this computer. Nothing is uploaded to Open Accountant. Claude does the thinking, so no API key is needed.

Import a bank export (CSV from Chase, Amex, Bank of America and most other banks, or OFX, QFX or QIF), then ask things like "Where did my money go last month?" or "Categorize my uncategorized transactions". Claude asks before anything is added or changed. Open the local dashboard any time for charts and tables.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Which profile is open, how many transactions, the dates they cover, and how many still need a category.

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Import a bank export (CSV, OFX, QFX or QIF) or a folder of them. Asks before adding anything.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Find transactions with a short plain-English query.

tools.name: get_spending_summary
tools.description: Spending by category for this month, quarter or year, compared with the one before.

tools.name: get_profit_loss
tools.description: Income, expenses and net for a period.

tools.name: get_net_worth
tools.description: Net worth summary, trend or balance sheet.

tools.name: list_uncategorized
tools.description: Transactions that have no category yet.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category names you can use.

tools.name: categorize_transactions
tools.description: Set the category of up to 100 transactions at once. Asks before changing anything.

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: Budgets against actual spending for a month.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: Savings and spending goals and their progress.

tools.name: set_budget
tools.description: Set a category's monthly limit. Asks before changing anything.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Change a goal's target, date or status. Asks before changing anything.

tools.name: set_tax_flag
tools.description: Mark or unmark a transaction as tax-deductible. Asks before changing anything.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Open Wilson's local dashboard in your browser.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which set of books to open, e.g. "default", "business" or "household". Letters, digits, - and _ only.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where Wilson keeps your books. Leave it as is unless you moved your Open Accountant folder.

allow_changes.title: Allow imports and changes
allow_changes.description: Let Claude import files and change categories, budgets and goals (it still asks you first). Turn off for read-only access.
